title: Immunology Laboratory
objective: Complete immunology workflow from sample reception to archiving
content: Immunology Laboratory notebook template with 10 predefined workflow pages for sample processing, analysis, and archiving.

pages.title: Sample Reception
pages.instructions: Verify sample receipt and condition. Check that all samples match the manifest. Inspect for damage, proper labeling, and temperature compliance.
pages.content: Sample Reception - Batch verification of incoming samples

manifestColumns.label: Unique Parent Sample ID
manifestColumns.description: Primary unique identifier assigned to the parent sample tube.

manifestColumns.label: Sample Type
manifestColumns.description: Type of biological matrix (e.g., serum, plasma, PBMC, whole blood).

manifestColumns.label: Collection Date & Time
manifestColumns.description: Date and time the sample was collected from the patient.

manifestColumns.label: Sample Volume (mL)
manifestColumns.description: Volume of sample received, expressed in millilitres or microlitres.

manifestColumns.label: Project Name/ID
manifestColumns.description: Name or identifier of the immunology study or project this sample belongs to.

manifestColumns.label: Delivery Manifest Reference
manifestColumns.description: Reference number printed on the delivery manifest accompanying this shipment.

manifestColumns.label: Reception Date & Time
manifestColumns.description: Date and time the sample was formally received and logged into the laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Source/Origin
manifestColumns.description: Geographic or institutional origin of the sample.

manifestColumns.label: Storage Condition on Arrival
manifestColumns.description: Temperature or storage state of the sample when it arrived at the laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Transport Temperature
manifestColumns.description: Temperature maintained during transport from collection site to the laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Receiving Personnel
manifestColumns.description: Name or ID of the laboratory staff member who received the sample shipment.

manifestColumns.label: Manifest Verification Status
manifestColumns.description: Status of manifest verification against physical samples (Verified, Pending, Discrepancy).

manifestColumns.label: Patient ID
manifestColumns.description: De-identified patient or donor identifier linked to this sample.

manifestColumns.label: Notes
manifestColumns.description: Any additional remarks or observations about this sample.

pages.title: Initial Processing
pages.instructions: Perform initial processing steps including centrifugation and visual inspection. Record any quality issues.
pages.content: Initial Processing - Centrifugation and sample preparation

pages.title: Additional Assays
pages.instructions: Record test type, operator, reagents used, and results
pages.content: Additional Assays - Supplementary tests prior to extraction

pages.title: Child Sample Creation
pages.instructions: Create child samples for specific test requirements. Route samples to appropriate destinations (internal analysis, external lab, or storage).
pages.content: Child Sample Creation - Branching workflow for sample routing

pages.title: Plate Setup
pages.instructions: Assign samples to analyzer plates with well coordinates. Use row-major ordering (A1, A2...B1, B2...).
pages.content: Plate Setup - Well coordinate assignment for analyzer

pages.title: Analyzer Results
pages.instructions: Import analyzer results from CSV/Excel. Match results to samples by well coordinate or sample ID. Review and validate results.
pages.content: Analyzer Results - Import and match analyzer output

pages.title: Post-Analysis
pages.instructions: Perform post-analysis review and quality checks. Flag any outliers or failed QC samples for repeat testing.
pages.content: Post-Analysis - Individual sample review and QC

pages.title: Compilation
pages.instructions: Compile final results and prepare for reporting. Aggregate data from all test runs.

pages.title: Archiving
pages.instructions: Archive samples and finalize documentation. Assign storage locations and complete audit trail.
pages.content: Archiving - Final storage assignment and documentation

pages.title: Reporting & REDCap Integration
pages.instructions: Finalize results and integrate with external systems. Generate final reports (summary, detailed, QC, statistical, or audit trail). Configure REDCap project settings and submit validated data. Archive completed samples with full audit trail.
pages.content: Reporting and REDCap Integration - External system integration and final reporting
